title: Gobag Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gobag:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often gobag metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on gobag metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It gives you how often your gobag metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
